relationships.subject: Central sensitization
relationships.evidence_quote: It is known that fibromyalgia is caused by a central sensitization phenomenon

relationships.subject: ASIC3
relationships.evidence_quote: The important role of ASIC3 activation on nociceptors that innervate the skeletal muscle in the induction of diffuse hyperalgesia was suggested by the results of an animal study

relationships.subject: NMDA receptor
relationships.evidence_quote: NMDA glutamate receptors in the CNS play a central role in the induction and maintenance of widespread hyperalgesia

key_findings: Review of fibromyalgia: central sensitization, glutamate/NMDA, ASIC3 and BDNF-CREB alterations.
